title: New Zealand election: final results show ruling coalition needs minor party to govern
summary_full: Incumbent prime minister Christopher Luxon loses majority and needs support of Opportunity party to remain in power, or country faces another electionThe final results of New Zealand’s general election show the incumbent rightwing coalition will need the support of a centrist newcomer party to form a government, and to avoid sending the country back to the polls.Preliminary results on 7 November handed the National party and its two coalition partners, the populist New Zealand First and libertarian Act parties, a slim two-seat majority, making the election too close to call until final votes were tallied.
